entities.summary: Hindu Rights Action Force, better known by its acronym HINDRAF ; is a Malaysian Hindu-activist non-governmental organisation (NGO) whose slogan is Makkal Sakti  or Kuasa Rakyat translated as People's Power. The organisation began as a coalition of 30 Hindu NGOs committed to the preservation of Hindu rights and heritage in a multiracial Malaysia.
